reason: A writing-assistance plugin that analyzes novel characters, tracks their appearance weight, maintains personality profiles, and detects behavior deviations against established characterization.

summaries.zh: 用于分析小说人物特征、统计出场权重、维护角色侧写并检测正文行为偏离的人物一致性写作辅助插件。
summaries.en: A writing-assistance plugin for analyzing novel characters, tracking appearance weight, maintaining character profiles, and detecting deviations from established characterization.

capabilities: Reads novel project files such as character cards and manuscript text
Writes and updates character profile files under the project lore directory
Computes local character appearance and weighting statistics
Uses an LLM API for character profiling and behavior-deviation analysis
